viewport-organization.copy: Viewport organization prioritizes the topbar utility cluster by task value: language, grid, and contrast remain compact while search stays an input.

items.title: Phone topbar
items.rule: Keep language, grid, and contrast compact beside the open search input.

items.title: Docs toolbar
items.rule: Use selected state only for utilities that are actually on, such as grid or contrast.

items.title: Dense tools
items.rule: Preserve icon legibility and target size before adding more utilities.
